gems.name: upload_inspector
gems.info: Fail-closed structural inspection and content disarm and reconstruction (CDR) for untrusted uploads. UploadInspector.sanitize writes a clean copy keeping only parts known to be safe (strips EXIF/GPS, XMP, comments, unknown chunks/boxes from PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, MP4, QuickTime; rebuilds SVG from an allowlist; neutralizes CSV formulas; optional ruby-vips re-encode). Structural checks reject macros, PDF JavaScript/actions, OLE objects, remote templates, DDE, zip bombs, image polyglots, and dangerous filenames (hidden extensions, bidi tricks). Malware scanning (0.10): pluggable scanner adapters including ClamAV (clamd INSTREAM via pure-Ruby socket), custom command binaries, and AWS GuardDuty Malware Protection for S3 tags. Integrations & CLI (0.11): upload_inspector CLI (check, scan directory, sanitize), signed Active Storage analyzer, Shrine plugin, CarrierWave mixin, and Rack middleware. Works with Rails uploads, S3 presigned URLs, and plain IO in a resource-limited child process. Pure Ruby (libvips only for optional re-encode). Usage and options: https://akarui2004.github.io/upload_inspector
